title: somersaulting — meditation

phrases.translation: 倒毛跟斗；倒筋斗跳；后空翻

sentences.sentence: Trained dogs did somersaults on a man's shoulders.
sentences.translation: 一些受过训练的狗在一个男子的肩膀上翻筋斗。

sentences.sentence: He lunged at me, grabbing me violently.
sentences.translation: 他向我猛冲过来，狠狠地抓住了我。

sentences.sentence: I have to confess I acquired this belief from the book Guinness World Records.
sentences.translation: 我得说我是从《吉尼斯世界纪录》这本书里找到了这一信仰。

sentences.sentence: They have been married for seven years, but it took the Hallquists until this year to contact Guinness World Records.
sentences.translation: 霍尔奎斯特夫妇已经结婚七年，但是直到今年他们才联系了吉尼斯世界纪录。

phrases.translation: 近似值，近似价值；概算价值
近似数，近似值；大概的数目

sentences.sentence: What is the approximate number of students in each class?
sentences.translation: 每个班大致有多少学生？

sentences.sentence: These percentages are only approximate.
sentences.translation: 这些百分比仅仅是近似值。

sentences.sentence: The journey took approximately seven hours.
sentences.translation: 旅程大约花了七个小时。

sentences.sentence: Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
sentences.translation: 通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。

sentences.sentence: Bake for 20 minutes in a conventional oven; 8 in a microwave.
sentences.translation: 在传统的烤炉中烘烤20分钟，在微波炉里则烤8分钟。

sentences.sentence: a strong believer in conventional morals
sentences.translation: 坚守传统道德观念的人

phrases.translation: 又哭又笑;欢乐与悲伤[亦作 tears and laughter]
捧腹大笑；笑得直不起腰

sentences.sentence: Foster joined in the laughter.
sentences.translation: 福斯特也跟着笑了起来。

sentences.sentence: He looked shocked, then burst into laughter (= started laughing ).
sentences.translation: 他一脸的震惊，接着便放声大笑起来。

phrases.translation: 社会现实；社会实体；社会实在
真人秀；逼真的表演（真实）；（根据真实故事制作而成的）社会传真节目
严酷的现实；残酷的现实

sentences.sentence: the distinction between fantasy and reality
sentences.translation: 幻想和现实之间的区别

sentences.sentence: TV is used as an escape from reality .
sentences.translation: 电视成了逃避现实的一种方式。

sentences.sentence: I think the government has lost touch with reality (= no longer understands what is real or true ) .
sentences.translation: 我认为政府已经脱离了现实。

sentences.sentence: political realities
sentences.translation: 政治现实

sentences.sentence: The paperless office may one day become a reality .
sentences.translation: 无纸化办公室有一天可能会成为现实。

sentences.sentence: Outwardly she seemed confident but in reality she felt extremely nervous.
sentences.translation: 表面上看，她显得信心十足，而实际上她紧张得要命。

sentences.sentence: Once we make the adjustments for inflation, the fall in interest rates is quite small.
sentences.translation: 如果我们按通货膨胀调整，利率降幅其实很小。

phrases.translation: [美国口语]勇敢地承受；坚持到底
非常坚强的人；不易动感情的人；自信者
大胆果断的人；暴躁的人
严厉的爱（指为起到帮助作用而严厉地对待有问题的人）

sentences.sentence: It was a tough race.
sentences.translation: 比赛打得很艰难。

sentences.sentence: She’s had a tough life.
sentences.translation: 她的生活十分艰辛。

sentences.sentence: The company admitted that it had been a tough year.
sentences.translation: 公司承认那是艰难的一年。

sentences.sentence: Tough decisions will have to be made.
sentences.translation: 必须作出艰难的决定。

sentences.sentence: The reporters were asking a lot of tough questions .
sentences.translation: 记者们问了很多难以回答的问题。

sentences.sentence: I find his books pretty tough going (= difficult to read ) .
sentences.translation: 我发现他的书很难读。

sentences.sentence: Gage predicted the president’s proposal would be a tough sell (= something that is difficult to persuade someone about ) before Congress.
sentences.translation: 盖奇预言总统的提议在国会很难通过。

sentences.sentence: He’s as tough as nails – a good man to have on the team.
sentences.translation: 他是个很坚韧的人——队里有他真好。

sentences.sentence: Washington played tough in the second half of the game.
sentences.translation: 华盛顿队在比赛的下半场表现得十分顽强。

sentences.sentence: Force is only justified in extreme circumstances.
sentences.translation: 只有在极端情况下才可以使用武力。

sentences.sentence: Zimmer slipped and nearly fell on a pool of vomit.
sentences.translation: 齐默滑了一跤，差点儿摔倒在一滩呕吐物上。

sentences.sentence: a gymnastics display
sentences.translation: 体操表演

sentences.sentence: She never gets any exercise – she must be really unfit.
sentences.translation: 她从不锻炼——身体一定很不好。

sentences.sentence: The house was unfit for human habitation(= not good enough to live in ).
sentences.translation: 这房子不宜住人。

sentences.sentence: Politics fascinated Franklin's father.
sentences.translation: 政治让富兰克林的父亲着迷。

sentences.sentence: The idea of travelling through time fascinates me.
sentences.translation: 穿越时光的想法深深吸引着我。

sentences.sentence: Yoga involves breathing exercises, stretching, and meditation.
sentences.translation: 瑜伽包括呼吸训练、伸展和冥想。

text:
英语词汇 · 人教高中 · 第 144 单元

somersaulting
音标：英 /'sʌməsɒlt; -sɔːlt/  美 /'sʌmɚsɔlt/
n. 翻筋斗
短语：backward somersault — 倒毛跟斗；倒筋斗跳；后空翻
例句：Trained dogs did somersaults on a man's shoulders.
一些受过训练的狗在一个男子的肩膀上翻筋斗。

lunge
音标：英 /lʌn(d)ʒ/  美 /lʌndʒ/
n. 刺
v. 越近，前冲
例句：He lunged at me, grabbing me violently.
他向我猛冲过来，狠狠地抓住了我。

Ashrita Furman
阿什里塔.弗曼

Guinness
音标：美 /'ɡinis/
吉尼斯
短语：guinness world records — 吉尼斯世界记录
例句：I have to confess I acquired this belief from the book Guinness World Records.
我得说我是从《吉尼斯世界纪录》这本书里找到了这一信仰。
例句：They have been married for seven years, but it took the Hallquists until this year to contact Guinness World Records.
霍尔奎斯特夫妇已经结婚七年，但是直到今年他们才联系了吉尼斯世界纪录。

Guiness Book of World Records
《吉尼斯世界纪录大全》

approximate
音标：英 /ə'prɒksɪmət/  美 /ə'prɑksɪmət/
adj. 近似的，大概的
短语：approximate solution — [计]近似解
短语：approximate calculation — 近似计算
短语：approximate method — 近似法
短语：approximate formula — 近似公式；近真公式
短语：approximate value — 近似值，近似价值；概算价值
短语：approximate expression — 近似式
短语：approximate analysis — n. 近似分析
短语：approximate number — 近似数，近似值；大概的数目
短语：approximate treatment — 近似处理；近似计算
例句：What is the approximate number of students in each class?
每个班大致有多少学生？
例句：These percentages are only approximate.
这些百分比仅仅是近似值。

approximately
音标：英 /ə'prɒksɪmətlɪ/  美 /ə'prɑksɪmətli/
adv. 近似地，大约地
短语：approximately equal — 约等于，近似等于
例句：The journey took approximately seven hours.
旅程大约花了七个小时。

conventional
音标：英 /kən'venʃ(ə)n(ə)l/  美 /kən'vɛnʃənl/
adj. 传统的；习俗的
短语：conventional method — 常规方法；习用方法
短语：conventional type — 常规型式
短语：conventional industries — 传统产业
短语：conventional weapon — [军]常规武器
短语：conventional forces — 常规部队
短语：conventional war — 常规战争
例句：Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。
例句：Bake for 20 minutes in a conventional oven; 8 in a microwave.
在传统的烤炉中烘烤20分钟，在微波炉里则烤8分钟。
例句：a strong believer in conventional morals
坚守传统道德观念的人

laughter
音标：英 /'lɑːftə/  美 /'læftɚ/
n. 笑，笑声
短语：burst into laughter — 突然大笑
短语：laughter and tears — 又哭又笑;欢乐与悲伤[亦作 tears and laughter]
短语：roar with laughter — 哄堂大笑
短语：canned laughter — ［俚］预先录制的笑声
短语：convulsed with laughter — 捧腹大笑；笑得直不起腰
例句：Foster joined in the laughter.
福斯特也跟着笑了起来。
例句：He looked shocked, then burst into laughter (= started laughing ).
他一脸的震惊，接着便放声大笑起来。

reality
音标：英 /rɪ'ælɪtɪ/  美 /rɪ'æləti/
n. 真实，事实
短语：in reality — 实际上；事实上
短语：virtual reality — 虚拟现实
短语：social reality — 社会现实；社会实体；社会实在
短语：reality show — 真人秀；逼真的表演（真实）；（根据真实故事制作而成的）社会传真节目
短语：sense of reality — 真实感
短语：reality tv — 现实电视
短语：harsh reality — 严酷的现实；残酷的现实
短语：reality check — 现实检查；现状核实
短语：economic reality — 经济现实；经济实况
短语：reality tv show — 真人秀；电视真人秀
短语：ultimate reality — 上帝；最高实在
短语：physical reality — 物理实在；物理现实
例句：the distinction between fantasy and reality
幻想和现实之间的区别
例句：TV is used as an escape from reality .
电视成了逃避现实的一种方式。
例句：I think the government has lost touch with reality (= no longer understands what is real or true ) .
我认为政府已经脱离了现实。
例句：political realities
政治现实
例句：The paperless office may one day become a reality .
无纸化办公室有一天可能会成为现实。

in reality
实际上，现实
例句：Outwardly she seemed confident but in reality she felt extremely nervous.
表面上看，她显得信心十足，而实际上她紧张得要命。

ajustment
n. 调节，调整
例句：Once we make the adjustments for inflation, the fall in interest rates is quite small.
如果我们按通货膨胀调整，利率降幅其实很小。

tough
音标：英 /tʌf/  美 /tʌf/
adj. 困难的；强硬的
adv. 顽强地
短语：tough guy — [美口]硬汉
短语：tough it out — [美国口语]勇敢地承受；坚持到底
短语：get tough with — [口语]对…强硬起来
短语：tough cookie — 非常坚强的人；不易动感情的人；自信者
短语：tough luck — 坏运气；真不走运
短语：tough nut — 大胆果断的人；暴躁的人
短语：tough love — 严厉的爱（指为起到帮助作用而严厉地对待有问题的人）
短语：hang tough — 坚持到底，顽强不屈
例句：It was a tough race.
比赛打得很艰难。
例句：She’s had a tough life.
她的生活十分艰辛。
例句：The company admitted that it had been a tough year.
公司承认那是艰难的一年。
例句：Tough decisions will have to be made.
必须作出艰难的决定。
例句：The reporters were asking a lot of tough questions .
记者们问了很多难以回答的问题。
例句：I find his books pretty tough going (= difficult to read ) .
我发现他的书很难读。
例句：Gage predicted the president’s proposal would be a tough sell (= something that is difficult to persuade someone about ) before Congress.
盖奇预言总统的提议在国会很难通过。
例句：He’s as tough as nails – a good man to have on the team.
他是个很坚韧的人——队里有他真好。
例句：Washington played tough in the second half of the game.
华盛顿队在比赛的下半场表现得十分顽强。

extreme
adj. 极端的，偏激的
例句：Force is only justified in extreme circumstances.
只有在极端情况下才可以使用武力。

vomit
音标：英 /'vɒmɪt/  美 /'vɑmɪt/
n. 呕吐物
例句：Zimmer slipped and nearly fell on a pool of vomit.
齐默滑了一跤，差点儿摔倒在一滩呕吐物上。

gymnastics
n. 体操，体能训练
例句：a gymnastics display
体操表演

gymnastically
adv. 体能训练方面

unfit
音标：英 /ʌn'fɪt/
adj. 不太健康的；不适宜的
例句：She never gets any exercise – she must be really unfit.
她从不锻炼——身体一定很不好。
例句：The house was unfit for human habitation(= not good enough to live in ).
这房子不宜住人。

fascinate
音标：英 /'fæsɪneɪt/  美 /'fæsə'net/
vt. 使着迷，入迷
例句：Politics fascinated Franklin's father.
政治让富兰克林的父亲着迷。
例句：The idea of travelling through time fascinates me.
穿越时光的想法深深吸引着我。

meditation
音标：英 /medɪ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,mɛdɪ'teʃən/
n. 沉思，冥想
例句：Yoga involves breathing exercises, stretching, and meditation.
瑜伽包括呼吸训练、伸展和冥想。
